operations.summary: Create a platform billing bridge key
operations.description: Bearer session of the platform owner (platform session, billing_bridge.manage), MFA step-up proof (audience billing-bridge, action billing_bridge.key.create) in step_up_token; 403 mfa_step_up_required without it. ip_allowlist is required (1–32 addresses or CIDR networks, no /0). The secret is returned once in this response and only its pepper-derived seed is stored. Audit billing_bridge.key.created.

responses.description: The key and its one-time secret.

fields.name: secret
fields.description: Shown once; sign requests with it (cbs_ + 43 base64url characters).

operations.summary: Rotate the secret of a platform billing bridge key
operations.description: Step-up action billing_bridge.key.rotate bound to the key id. The old secret stops working at once; the new one is returned once. 409 revision_conflict on a stale expected_revision, 409 key_revoked for a revoked key. Audit billing_bridge.key.rotated.

responses.description: The key and its new one-time secret.

Audited as billing_bridge.settings.updated.
